packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The parties that take part in the process and originate or receive its information.

packages.name: Flights
packages.description: The flight, turn-round, aircraft, and the flight plan and slot that describe them, including the flight's operational status.

packages.name: Timings
packages.description: The time quantities that describe a flight's progress, each with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance.

packages.name: Milestones
packages.description: The sixteen events, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

packages.name: Systems
packages.description: The technical systems that hold, compute, and display the process information, including the CDM platform and its actions.

packages.name: Messages
packages.description: The messages exchanged between stakeholders and systems.

classes.name: CdmPartner
classes.definition: A party that takes part in the Airport CDM process and originates or receives information about a flight.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifies the CDM partner.

operations.name: receiveNotification
operations.description: Receives information relayed by a milestone process, e.g. 'inform all relevant Airport CDM Partners'.

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline that submits the ATC Flight Plan and provides estimates such as TOBT.

operations.name: submitFlightPlan
operations.description: Submits the ICAO ATC Flight Plan; the AO must provide correct information before the first E-DPI (Milestone 1).

operations.name: provideTobt
operations.description: Provides the most accurate TOBT taking into account the operational situation, integrating own strategy to compute TOBT (Milestone 9).

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The party that undertakes ground handling operations and provides ready and TOBT-related information.

operations.name: commenceGroundHandling
operations.description: Provides the Actual Commence of Ground Handling time (ACGT) (Milestone 8).

operations.name: provideArdt
operations.description: Provides the Actual Ready Time when the aircraft is ready for start up/push-back (Milestone 12).

classes.name: AtcUnit
classes.definition: An air traffic control unit (ACC, Approach, Tower) that receives the flight plan, issues TSAT, and approves start-up.

attributes.name: unitType
attributes.description: e.g. ACC, Approach Control Unit, Tower/TWR FDPS.

operations.name: issueTsat
operations.description: Issues the Target Start-Up Approval Time t-minutes before EOBT, t agreed locally (Milestone 10).

operations.name: confirmTsatToPilot
operations.description: Confirms TSAT to the pilot in order to maintain the aircraft in the pre-departure sequence (Milestone 13).

operations.name: approveStartUp
operations.description: Grants start-up approval / push-back clearance (Milestone 14).

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The network management function that issues CTOT, receives DPI messages, and monitors flight progress.

operations.name: issueCtot
operations.description: Issues a CTOT at EOBT-2hr to relevant ATS units and the departure aerodrome for regulated flights (Milestone 2).

operations.name: confirmFlight
operations.description: Confirms the flight following consistency checking, allowing further local processing (Milestone 1).

classes.name: Outstation
classes.definition: The departure aerodrome (ADEP) of an inbound flight, which provides the ATOT for that flight.

operations.name: provideAtot
operations.description: Provides the ATOT from the outstation, available with accuracy +/- 1 minute (Milestone 3).

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: An arriving or departing flight tracked through the CDM process, carrying its operational status and time quantities.

attributes.name: flightId
attributes.description: Identifies the flight.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Arrival or departure leg of a turn-round.

attributes.name: operationalStatus
attributes.description: The status set by each milestone, e.g. INITIATED, AIRBORNE, LANDED, SEQUENCED, DEPARTED/TAKE OFF.

attributes.name: exot
attributes.description: Estimated Taxi-Out Time calculated by ATC based on predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and holding position waiting period (Milestone 9).

attributes.name: exit
attributes.description: Estimated taxi-in time used with ELDT to compute EIBT and, with ALDT, to update EIBT (Milestones 4, 6).

attributes.name: sobt
attributes.description: Scheduled Off-Block Time shared by ATC, Network Operations and Stand/Gate Management (Milestone 9).

attributes.name: eobt
attributes.description: Estimated Off-Block Time used as the reference for the process timeline (Milestones 1,2,9).

attributes.name: tobt
attributes.description: Target Off-Block Time, entered by AO/GH or calculated automatically, updated at multiple milestones.

attributes.name: aobt
attributes.description: Actual Off-Block Time, when the aircraft pushes back/vacates the parking position (Milestone 15).

attributes.name: eldt
attributes.description: Estimated Landing Time, updated using ATOT and Estimated Elapsed Time, and by FUM messages and radar (Milestones 1,2,3,4,5).

attributes.name: aldt
attributes.description: Actual Landing Time, accuracy +/- 1 minute (Milestone 6).

attributes.name: eibt
attributes.description: Estimated In-Block Time computed using ELDT and estimated taxi-in time, or ALDT+EXIT (Milestones 1,4,6).

attributes.name: aibt
attributes.description: Actual In-Block Time, accuracy +/- 1 minute (Milestone 7).

attributes.name: etot
attributes.description: Estimated Take-Off Time updated for a departure at flight plan activation (Milestone 1).

attributes.name: ttot
attributes.description: Target Take-Off Time, calculated basis EIBT+MTTT+EXOT or TOBT+EXOT, updated with a tolerance before Network Operations is informed (Milestones 2-15).

attributes.name: ctot
attributes.description: Calculated Take-Off Time issued by Network Operations for regulated flights at EOBT-2hr (Milestone 2).

attributes.name: atot
attributes.description: Actual Take-Off Time, from outstation (Milestone 3) or at departure (Milestone 16), accuracy +/- 1 minute.

attributes.name: acgt
attributes.description: Actual Commence of Ground Handling Time, accuracy +/- 1 minute (Milestone 8).

attributes.name: asbt
attributes.description: Actual Start Boarding Time, accuracy +/- 1 minute (Milestone 11).

attributes.name: ardt
attributes.description: Actual Ready Time, accuracy +/- 1 minute (Milestone 12).

attributes.name: asrt
attributes.description: Actual Start-Up Request Time, accuracy +/- 1 minute (Milestone 13).

attributes.name: asat
attributes.description: Actual Start-Up Approval Time, accuracy +/- 1 minute (Milestone 14).

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: An aircraft turn-round normally including an arriving and a departing flight, each with two related flight plans.

attributes.name: mttt
attributes.description: Minimum/estimated turn-round period used to calculate TOBT and TTOT for the departing flight (Milestones 6,7,8).

classes.name: Aircraft
classes.definition: The physical aircraft operating a flight, whose type and registration may be updated from the flight plan.

attributes.name: registration
attributes.description: Aircraft registration provided before the first E-DPI (Milestone 1).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Type of aircraft, which may be updated from the ATC Flight Plan (Milestone 1).

classes.name: AtcFlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO flight plan submitted by the Aircraft Operator and distributed by IFPS, corresponding to the airport slot programme.

attributes.name: departureAerodrome
attributes.description: Departure aerodrome (ADEP) named in the flight plan.

attributes.name: destinationAerodrome
attributes.description: Destination aerodrome named in the flight plan.

attributes.name: estimatedElapsedTime
attributes.description: Elapsed time on the FPL used with ATOT to calculate ELDT (Milestone 3).

attributes.name: isRepetitive
attributes.description: Whether a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) has been submitted covering daily or weekly flights (Milestone 1).

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot programme entry against which the ATC Flight Plan is checked for consistency.

attributes.name: slotReference
attributes.description: Reference identifying the coordinated slot the flight plan must correspond to (Milestone 1).

classes.name: TimeQuantity
classes.definition: A named time quantity describing a flight's progress, combining a prefix (Scheduled, Estimated, Target, Actual, Calculated) with an event, kept as a history of successive values.

attributes.name: quantityName
attributes.description: The named quantity, e.g. TOBT, EOBT, ELDT, EIBT, ETOT, TTOT, CTOT, ATOT, ALDT, AIBT, ACGT, ASBT, ARDT, ASRT, ASAT, AOBT, SOBT.

attributes.name: event
attributes.description: The event this quantity describes, e.g. Off-Block, In-Block, Landing, Take-Off, Start-Up Approval.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The current time value of this quantity.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: Who provided this value, e.g. ATC, AO/GH, ACARS, radar system.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: Stated accuracy, e.g. +/- 1 minute for actual times.

attributes.name: updatedAt
attributes.description: Time this value was recorded.

operations.name: update
operations.description: Appends a new successive value with its originator and time of update, rather than overwriting, so a turn-round can be analysed afterwards.

classes.name: ScheduledTime
classes.definition: A scheduled-prefix time quantity such as SOBT.

classes.name: EstimatedTime
classes.definition: An estimated-prefix time quantity such as EOBT, ELDT, EIBT, ETOT.

classes.name: TargetTime
classes.definition: A target-prefix time quantity such as TOBT, TTOT, TSAT.

classes.name: ActualTime
classes.definition: An actual-prefix time quantity such as ATOT, ALDT, AIBT, ACGT, ASBT, ARDT, ASRT, ASAT, AOBT.

classes.name: CalculatedTime
classes.definition: A calculated-prefix time quantity such as CTOT.

classes.name: Milestone
classes.definition: One of the sixteen CDM events, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect on operational status, and procedure.

attributes.name: milestoneNumber
attributes.description: The milestone's number, 1 to 16.

attributes.name: milestoneName
attributes.description: The milestone's name, e.g. 'ATC Flight Plan Activated'.

attributes.name: definitionText
attributes.description: The definition of the milestone as stated in the document.

attributes.name: triggeredBy
attributes.description: What triggers this milestone's process, as stated under Procedures.

attributes.name: operationalStatusChange
attributes.description: The operational status the flight changes to at this milestone.

operations.name: recordOccurrence
operations.description: Records that the milestone has occurred for a flight, at the stated time.

classes.name: FlightPlanActivation
classes.definition: Milestone 1: the ICAO flight plan is submitted to ATC and the Airport CDM Platform is initiated for the flight.

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: Checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent.

operations.name: updateEstimates
operations.description: Updates ELDT and EIBT for an arrival, and ETOT for a departure.

operations.name: sendFirstEdpi
operations.description: Sends the first E-DPI only if consistent information has been provided; not sent if information is missing or inconsistent.

classes.name: Eobt2HrCheck
classes.definition: Milestone 2: at EOBT-2hr, flights are known as regulated or not and receive a CTOT if regulated.

operations.name: checkFlightEstimatesConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH flight estimates are consistent with the ATC Flight Plan at EOBT-2hrs, before or after take-off from outstation.

operations.name: calculateTtot
operations.description: Calculates TTOT taking into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT if later than EOBT+EXOT; if TOBT is manually input it overrides, so TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT.

operations.name: markAsRegulated
operations.description: Marks appropriate fields as REGULATED for a flight receiving a CTOT.

classes.name: TakeOffFromOutstation
classes.definition: Milestone 3: the ATOT from the outstation (ADEP) is recorded.

operations.name: checkLandingEstimateConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH estimated landing time after take-off from outstation is consistent with the outbound ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: calculateEldt
operations.description: Calculates ELDT using ATOT and the Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL.

operations.name: calculateTtot
operations.description: Calculates TTOT as EIBT+MTTT+EXOT, or EOBT+EXOT if EOBT is later than EIBT+MTTT, or TOBT+EXOT if TOBT is available, respecting a TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes before informing Network Operations.

classes.name: LocalRadarUpdate
classes.definition: Milestone 4: the flight enters the FIR or local airspace of the destination airport.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT.

operations.name: computeEibt
operations.description: Computes EIBT using the ELDT and the estimated taxi-in time (EXIT).

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotChanges
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: FinalApproach
classes.definition: Milestone 5: the flight enters the Final Approach phase at the destination airport.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotChanges
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: Landed
classes.definition: Milestone 6: ALDT, the time an aircraft touches down on a runway.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: updateEibt
operations.description: Updates EIBT according to ALDT + EXIT.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotChanges
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: InBlock
classes.definition: Milestone 7: AIBT, the time an aircraft arrives in-blocks; ACGT is considered to commence at AIBT.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: updateTobtTtot
operations.description: Updates TOBT and TTOT, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight.

classes.name: GroundHandlingStarted
classes.definition: Milestone 8: commencement of ground handling operations (ACGT), specific to first-of-day or long-parked flights.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: updateTobtTtot
operations.description: Updates TOBT, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight.

classes.name: FinalConfirmationOfTobt
classes.definition: Milestone 9: the time the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler provides its most accurate TOBT.

attributes.name: localParameterT
attributes.description: t minutes before EOBT, a parameter time agreed locally, when this confirmation is provided.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Performed at a predefined local time to confirm TOBT prior to TSAT issue and verify feasibility of ATC Flight Plan estimates given the updated TOBT.

operations.name: calculateExot
operations.description: ATC calculates and provides EXOT based on predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the Holding Position.

classes.name: TsatIssued
classes.definition: Milestone 10: the time ATC issues the Target Start-Up Approval Time.

attributes.name: localParameterT
attributes.description: t-minutes before EOBT, a parameter agreed locally, when TSAT is issued.

attributes.name: tobtUpdateThreshold
attributes.description: Locally defined tolerance for the number of TOBT updates permitted after TSAT has been issued.

operations.name: informPartnersOfTsat
operations.description: Informs all relevant partners of the TSAT allocated to the flight; Network Operations is informed by a T-DPI-s for non-regulated flights.

operations.name: checkTobtUpdateCount
operations.description: Checks whether the number of TOBT updates after TSAT has been issued exceeds a locally defined tolerance.

classes.name: BoardingStarts
classes.definition: Milestone 11: the gate is open for passengers to physically start boarding.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAsbt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start Boarding Time (ASBT).

operations.name: checkBoardingStatus
operations.description: At a locally defined time before TOBT, checks whether boarding starts in time to respect TOBT and informs the AO/GH if TOBT needs updating.

classes.name: AircraftReady
classes.definition: Milestone 12: all doors closed, boarding bridge removed, push-back vehicle connected, ready to taxi (ARDT).

operations.name: informPartnersOfArdt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of ARDT and that the aircraft is ready for start-up/push-back.

operations.name: alertIfNoReadyStatus
operations.description: At TOBT + tolerance, informs the AO/GH that TOBT has passed and no ARDT or Ready Status (RDY) has been received.

classes.name: StartUpRequested
classes.definition: Milestone 13: the time that start-up is requested (ASRT), based on pilot request.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAsrt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start-up Request Time (ASRT).

operations.name: alertIfNoStartUpRequested
operations.description: If start-up request is not made by TSAT + tolerance, informs the AO/GH that no start-up has been requested, who should update TOBT.

classes.name: StartUpApproved
classes.definition: Milestone 14: ASAT, the time an aircraft receives its start-up approval.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAsat
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of ASAT and that the aircraft has received start-up approval/push-back clearance.

operations.name: checkAsatAgainstTsat
operations.description: Checks if ASAT is in accordance with TSAT; if start-up approval is not granted at TSAT + tolerance, all partners are informed and the flight is re-sequenced.

classes.name: OffBlock
classes.definition: Milestone 15: AOBT, the time the aircraft pushes back/vacates the parking position.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAobt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of AOBT and that the aircraft has commenced push-back/taxi from parking position.

operations.name: checkTtotAgainstTolerance
operations.description: AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message; after the first A-DPI, checks TTOT updates against the TTOT tolerance before Network Operations is informed with a new A-DPI.

classes.name: TakeOff
classes.definition: Milestone 16: ATOT, the time an aircraft takes off from the runway.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAtot
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners about the actual take-off.

operations.name: removeFromDepartureSequence
operations.description: An airborne message is generated and the flight is removed from the departure sequence.

classes.name: AirportCdmPlatform
classes.definition: The Airport CDM Platform that is initiated for a flight, processes all available information, and performs ACISP actions.

operations.name: initiateForFlight
operations.description: Initiates the Airport CDM Platform for the flight and processes all available information (Milestone 1).

operations.name: markFieldsAsRegulated
operations.description: Marks appropriate fields as REGULATED (Milestone 2).

operations.name: computeTobtAutomatically
operations.description: Calculates a new TOBT automatically following an update of ELDT (Milestone 4).

operations.name: receiveInput
operations.description: Receives an input to the Airport CDM Platform, triggering the Aircraft Ready procedure (Milestone 12).

classes.name: AtcSystem
classes.definition: The ATC/radar/A-SMGCS system that detects a flight and provides actual times such as ATOT, ALDT and AIBT.

attributes.name: systemType
attributes.description: e.g. ACC, Approach Control Unit, A-SMGCS, Tower FDPS, Radar.

operations.name: detectFlight
operations.description: Detects a flight based upon the assigned SSR code when it crosses a defined FIR/ATC boundary or range/position/level (Milestones 4,5).

classes.name: Acars
classes.definition: The Aircraft Communications Addressing and Reporting System that signals ON/OFF/IN/OUT events.

operations.name: signalEvent
operations.description: Signals ACARS=ON (landing), ACARS=IN (in-block), ACARS=OUT (off-block), or ACARS=OFF (take-off).

classes.name: Ifps
classes.definition: The Integrated Initial Flight Plan Processing System that distributes the ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units.

operations.name: distributeFlightPlan
operations.description: Distributes the ATC Flight Plan submitted by the Aircraft Operator to all involved ATC units including departure and destination aerodromes.

classes.name: Etfms
classes.definition: The system Network Operations uses to monitor a flight's progress within 3 hours flying time of the destination airport.

operations.name: monitorProgress
operations.description: Monitors progress of the flight and triggers sending of a Flight Update Message (FUM) with updates of the flight's progress.

classes.name: DpiMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message exchanged with Network Operations as part of the DPI process.

attributes.name: sentTime
attributes.description: When the message was sent.

attributes.name: sender
attributes.description: The party or system sending the message.

classes.name: EDpiMessage
classes.definition: The first E-DPI message, sent only if consistent SOBT, aircraft registration and first destination data have been provided.

classes.name: TDpiMessage
classes.definition: The T-DPI message informing Network Operations of the updated take-off time estimate at EOBT-2hr.

classes.name: TDpiTMessage
classes.definition: The T-DPI-t message informing Network Operations of updated take-off time estimates at take-off from outstation.

classes.name: TDpiSMessage
classes.definition: The T-DPI-s message informing Network Operations of the TSAT for non-regulated flights.

classes.name: ADpiMessage
classes.definition: The A-DPI message that AOBT always triggers to Network Operations, and which carries updated TTOT thereafter.

classes.name: FumMessage
classes.definition: The Flight Update Message sent by Network Operations providing updates of the flight's progress.

classes.name: FsaMessage
classes.definition: The FSA message sent at Take-Off.

classes.name: MvtMessage
classes.definition: The MVT message sent at Take-Off.

classes.name: ReadyStatusMessage
classes.definition: The Ready Status (RDY) message confirming that the flight follows the indicated TOBT.

Milestone 8: the note that ACGT is considered to commence at AIBT for flights on a normal turn-round, as a general equivalence rule rather than an operation of a class, is not separately modelled.
Milestone 10: the local procedure to be followed 'according to local procedure' when the TOBT update threshold is exceeded is referenced but not itself specified in the document.
